description: This file defines a C# class 'BooleanNegationConverter' that implements the IValueConverter interface, providing functionality to negate boolean values for data binding in a XAML-based application.

classes.name: BooleanNegationConverter
classes.description: A value converter that negates boolean values for data binding.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its negation.

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Converts a boolean value back to its negation, used for two-way data binding.
